rows.rationale: A has a more distinctive editorial art direction (warm cream, high-contrast serif with orange italic accents, a dark ledger card) and a strong sticky scroll story where the Request/Authorize/Post/Settle steps drive a progressively lit flow diagram. B's staggered blur-in hero entrance is better choreographed than A's, whose first frames jump from blank to fully settled. But B's dark-and-lime look is more generic, it leaves a large empty void around scrollY 6750, and on mobile two customer quotes overlap into illegible text. Hover feedback is comparable: A uses underlines and lifted shadows, B uses pill fills and a lime glow.

Both share a near-identical dark/amber editorial art direction with serif italic headlines, a scroll-scrubbed manifesto paragraph and a cream-section rhythm, so the gap is small. A has the cleaner, quicker hero entrance and a strong exploded-cylinder sequence plus a horizontal materials track, but its closing outline 'HALO' wordmark is faint and its hovers are mostly subtle glows and underlines. B's product render is more detailed (knit texture, light seam), its scroll story is more varied (driver-layout diagram, stat counters, two-speaker stereo dots, colour-swatch pre-order card, large metallic HALO footer), and its buttons visibly change fill from ivory to amber with a glow. B's phone layout also keeps richer interactive modules (Conventional/Halo toggle, seat-level radar) without clipping, which tips it slightly ahead.

A has a striking nocturnal timber-house hero and a strong pinned 'Five seasons' process drawing, but its entrance shows the full hero at 80 ms, blanks to an empty scene by 520 ms and rebuilds it, which reads as a flash of content. Its transparent header also collides with scrolled text on desktop (2025px, 12150px) and mobile (logo over 'Case study' and 'Listen to the site'). B builds a more cohesive art direction from the tree-ring motif, with a horizontal works gallery and a process elevation that draws itself site → frame → envelope → light, and it stays clean on mobile. B's hover states (Enquire/commission fill inversion, CTA lift, underlines) are clearer than A's custom cursor dot, which covers the text and leaves Contact and Selected Work almost unchanged.

Both share a refined dark/cream serif art direction with staged hero entrances; A's scroll-driven exploded view of the speaker is a strong storytelling device, but its later sections drift toward generic cards and a pale placeholder-looking response chart. B offers more varied scroll choreography (an orange spec marquee, scrubbed text reveal, pinned zoom-ins on the light ring, knit and oak foot, an interactive room-calibration panel) and its hero builds atmosphere as the speaker materialises and the ring glows on. B's hover states give clear fills, whereas A's are mostly faint shadows or underlines. A's phone layout is slightly cleaner; on B the floating 'Pause motion / Replay intro' pill covers content and is cut off at the right edge.

B has the more cinematic art direction: a moonlit timber house that assembles while sun, mountains and headline rise in sequence. But its finished hero flashes at 80 ms, then the screen goes blank before the animation replays. Its transparent header also collides with body text while scrolling on desktop (around 2025px) and on mobile ('Case study' and 'Listen to the site' run under the logo). A sits blank under its header for roughly the first two seconds, which is its main weakness. After that it stays clean and consistent: tree-ring hero, horizontal project gallery, a process drawing where the house is built phase by phase, and a species marquee. Its hover states give clear fills and underlines, while B's custom cursor dot sits over the labels and Contact barely changes.

A has a more distinctive art direction: an editorial serif on warm ledger-paper, a restrained green accent, and light/dark section rhythm. Its scroll story is stronger too, with a pinned 'follow one payment' sequence where a curve advances through request/hold/settle while ledger rows fill in, plus a word-scrub manifesto, count-up stats and a live bill estimator. B is well made: its masked headline arrives sooner (complete by about 1.3 s versus about 2 s for A), with a glowing pulse and a ticking balance, and its lime-to-white CTA hover and tilting logo are lively. But its dark-mode, neon-lime dev-tool look is far more familiar, and on mobile it leaves a long empty dark gap before the reliability heading.

Both are polished dark night-themed pages with staged hero entrances (A's line-by-line serif headline and phone mock rising; B's masked headline reveal followed by phone, copy and CTA in sequence). B's scroll story is richer and more specific to the product: a pinned night timeline where the clock advances (11:25 pm, 2:57 am, 6:30 am) while the sleep-stage curve draws and the active step changes, plus a scroll-filled 'Sleep is not a switch' text reveal and an interactive mixer and wake dial. A has strong moments too (soundscape marquee, hypnogram, glowing moon finale), but its violet-gradient look is more familiar and one scroll frame leaves a large empty area. Hover feedback and mobile layouts are comparably clean on both, so the margin is small.

B has a more distinctive art direction: an editorial serif on a cream graph-paper ground, alternating with deep-green dark sections, against A's competent but familiar dark-with-lime fintech look. B's motion tells a stronger story, with a pinned 'A payment is a story' sequence whose request-hold-post-settle curve and ledger rows advance as you scroll, a drawn line under the hero, and scroll-linked word reveals. B does pay for this: its hero copy is still masked at about 1.7 s, and one quote is still blurred mid-reveal after a scroll. A's entrance finishes faster and more cleanly by 1.3 s, and its hover states are slightly more expressive (logo tilt, button turning white with a glow). Both phone layouts hold up; B's hash-chip row runs off the right edge and A leaves some empty dark space.

A spends nearly 3 s on a near-black intro screen with only a tiny glyph and the wordmark, and its desktop hero after the entrance is still sparse (title plus a forest strip). Its hover states use a cream cursor blob that covers labels like 'Atelier Norr' and 'Enquire' rather than clarifying them. B shows a confident editorial hero from the first frame and then draws in a tree-ring motif. Its scroll story is stronger: a pinned project gallery with counters and a process section where the timber frame builds up step by step (site, frame, skin, light), ending in a bold NORR footer. A's mobile layout is rich and robust, but B is clean too, apart from an intentionally clipped carousel and some empty space, and B reads as the more award-level site overall.

B has the richer art direction: a layered dusk landscape with a rising moon behind the phone, sunrise illustrations in the feature cards, gradient lilac-to-peach CTAs and a glowing 'Tonight can be different' finale, where A stays a more uniform gold-on-navy with long stretches of similar dark panels. A's pinned 'One night, in order' clock sequence (21:30 to 05:59) is the stronger single piece of scroll storytelling, but some of its scroll frames show empty card shells and a sparse, half-filled viewport, and its mobile capture at ~9234px has a large blank band at the top. Both heroes use comparable masked headline reveals with the phone mockup settling in by about 1.3 s, and both hover sets are tasteful but modest (A has an underline and a CTA glow; B has a pill highlight and a soft glow), so the decision rests on B's more distinctive visuals and cleaner mobile.

A has the richer art direction, with a glowing moon, layered violet dunes and a sunrise card, but its hero stays blank until about 850 ms and its scroll frames are mostly static section reveals. B's hero is composed by about 500 ms, and its pinned 'One night, in order' sequence advances the phone clock from 21:30 to 05:59, swaps the moon for the sun and redraws the hypnogram, which is real scroll-linked storytelling. B also has the clearer hover feedback (underline on nav links, brighter Get Drift button, glow on Start free), while A's hover states are barely perceptible. B loses some points for empty card shells around 7425px and a band of dead space in one mobile frame, but overall it reads as the more intentional motion piece.

A has the stronger scroll storytelling: a pinned 'one night' section moves the clock from 11:25 pm to 2:57 am to 6:30 am while the sleep-stage graph traces forward and the soundscape bars change, and the science copy brightens word by word. Its restrained near-black and amber editorial serif look is distinctive and well finished. B is polished too, with a quick staggered hero (done by about 1.3 s), a soundscape marquee, a bento feature grid, a moon CTA, a pause-motion control and gradient hover shifts, but its indigo and peach style is more generic and the frame at 4050 px is mostly empty. A's hero takes longer to finish (about 3.5 s) and its hover feedback is simpler, so the margin is small.

B renders a more convincing, material-rich product object and turns the sound technology into scroll-linked storytelling: the speaker explodes into labelled layers (tweeters, sideways bass, five parts), followed by a horizontally travelling materials gallery and an oversized 'Halo' wordmark finale. A is also polished, with a staggered headline-then-object entrance, a scroll-linked text reveal and a speaker that zooms into the glowing ring and knit. But its object reads as a flatter CSS cylinder, and on mobile its persistent 'Pause motion / Replay intro' pill sits over body copy. A's hover states are bolder: the buttons invert to a cream fill. B's are subtler glows and underlines, and B's mobile has one long empty dark gap between sections, but B still feels more award-level overall.

A has the clearer entrance choreography: the headline blurs in word by word and the ledger panel follows in a stagger. Its dark and lime styling is polished but a common dev-tool look, and the desktop scroll frames have long sparse dark stretches. On mobile, A's testimonial shows two quotes stacked on top of each other, leaving unreadable text. B's editorial cream, serif and vermilion art direction is more distinctive, and its sticky Request→Authorize→Post→Settle diagram that advances with scroll tells the product story better; its mobile layout is clean throughout, though its entrance only shows a blank frame and then the finished hero, and one stats row reads faint.

Both are polished dark/amber editorial launches with serif-italic headlines and staggered hero entrances, so the margin is narrow. B's scroll tells a stronger product story: a pinned exploded view of the speaker separates into labelled layers across several frames, followed by a horizontal materials gallery with tactile swatches and a cream feature-card section. A has richer diagrammatic sections (radar and ring visualisations) and a striking metallic HALO footer, plus more varied hover fills, but its hero product arrives later and dimmer, and its mid-page layouts read as more conventional card grids. On mobile both are clean, with no clipping.
